hits.snippet: # Schneider names Baumgardt, Wells as EVPs ahead of July 1 CEO transition by Ashley Kaster, FOX 11 News Mon, June 29, 2026 at 10:39 AM Updated Mon, June 29, 2026 at 4:14 PM Schneider National in Ashwaubenon \(WLUK\) GREEN BAY \(WLUK\) -- Schneider is making leadership changes under its new president and CEO\. As Jim Filter transitions into the role of President and Chief Executive Officer, Schneider National, Inc\., effective July 1, two Executive Vice Presidents will each lead a core portfolio\. Michael Baumgardt has been named Executive Vice President of Intermodal & Logistics and will report to Filter\. Steve Wells will join Schneider as Executive Vice President of Truckload, also reporting to Filter\. On Baumgardt’s team, Angela Prill was promoted to Senior Vice President of Intermodal Operations\. As previously announced, Mark Rourke, who has served as Schneider President and Chief Executive Officer since 2019, will assume the role of Executive Chairman of the Board of Directors and continue to contribute to Schneider’s strategic direction\.

On August 3, Scientific Games revealed that Pat McHugh, who has served as CEO, will retire on September 8 after nearly two decades with the company\. McHugh, a seasoned lottery industry expert with 30 years of experience, joined the company in 2004 and advanced through several roles before becoming CEO in 2022\. Throughout his tenure, McHugh contributed significantly to expanding the business internationally, enhancing the lottery game portfolio, and strengthening the company’s technology infrastructure\. Following his retirement, he will transition to the role of vice chair to support a smooth leadership handover\. The board has appointed Kevin Schneider as the interim CEO starting September 8\. # Can social media start over? Bluesky's CEO and COO deliver their case at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 \| TechCrunch The next era of social media might not be defined by a platform — it could be written by a protocol\. That’s the bet Bluesky is making, and at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, two of its leaders steering that bet will make their case in person\. Toni Schneider became Bluesky’s permanent CEO after leading the company on an interim basis since March\. He’s joined by COO Rose Wang, who has been with the company since 2021, for a Disrupt Stage session on whether social media can start over and where Bluesky fits into that potential reboot\. For founders building consumer products, the stakes couldn’t be higher\. If social media is entering a new era, it creates opportunities for entirely new products, business models, and communities to emerge\.
